## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 and claim-2 are adequately source-grounded.
- claim-3 remains conditional on integral Schur/Pieri presentation hypotheses that are unsupported in the evidence ledger.
- The requested degree-compatible unit-pivot order eliminating all remaining Schur columns is not constructed; only degrees \(d,d+1,d+2\) are treated.
- The assertion that \(P,R,T\) generate the entire degree-\(d+2\) relation lattice needs an explicit proof, including boundary omissions and \(T=R\) when \(\alpha=\beta=1\).
- The local unimodular minors do prove local saturation if that relation-lattice equality holds. Theorem 5.4 generation may then bypass higher-column elimination, but that is not the elimination construction explicitly required by the task.
